protocol.stage: A2, fixed-history completion audit before any new price design
protocol.scope: nonnegative laminar R/X model, observed-root linear response; independent small reference, not production WZZT
protocol.candidate_rule: all non-singleton WZZT dictionary blocks; tentative greedy blocks only determine ordering, never restrict full completions
protocol.greedy_rule: run observed data to stopping before screening; preserve errors and zero-effective labels without truth-based deletion
protocol.exact_reference: fit each complete laminar family once per dataset, then take min over families not containing C; optimize all nonnegative weights including zero
protocol.relaxation: symmetric nonnegative R and X; each diagonal >= corresponding off-diagonal; no row-sum dominance or upper bounds
protocol.lower_bound: max over anchors j of min over all inside i and outside k branch dual objectives; full block compares with known zero root
protocol.coefficient: R-only for P-only datasets; paired R-only and R+X diagnostics for P/Q confounding and X-only cases
protocol.confirmed_warning: conditional equality constraints are not applied in the main batch; separate wrong-confirmed negative example only
protocol.branch_cache: per dataset, reuse identical order/coefficient/confirmed branches; canonicalize symmetric root comparisons; report cache hits and actual LP calls
protocol.failure_policy: retain all failed family and branch results; no incomplete reference or empty compatible set used to claim necessity
protocol.truth_boundary: analysis function receives only historical P,Q,Y,initial B and declared coefficient; true positive blocks enter post-analysis labels only

balanced_partial_4.P: two common snapshots plus node0 two-slot prefix

nested_partial_4.P: two common snapshots plus node3 two-slot prefix

protocol.next_gate: first verify lower<=complete omission optimum, nonempty-model checks, zero/X-only/root cases, and actual runtime; then construct price-reachable contrast diagnostics without truth labels
protocol.reproducibility: deterministic inputs; freeze source/config hashes and environment; per-case results and failure preservation; source snapshots in archive
protocol.invalid_bound_guard: Any matrix lower bound above a feasible complete-omission upper bound is invalid and cannot imply necessity
protocol.posthoc_diagnostic: After the 17 locked cases, separately check X-only coefficient (0,1) on the existing X-only history; report its four blocks separately, never merge the 96-case denominator
